QUOTE: "ServerManager::execute ... is_denied(deny list)? → "Error: Permission denied for <tool>" result" and "Denial happens only at `ServerManager::execute`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says denial happens only at ServerManager::execute via is_denied. It also says the allow list only skips the prompt and that the approval callback never denies, so the deny list is the sole blocker.
